requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat the prior not-reportable decision as historical to its evidence snapshot rather than permanent
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill states that a prior not-reportable or insufficient-information state applies only to its documented Evidence Snapshot and must be reassessed when material facts change.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: evaluate the new material facts with current FDA awareness and MDR criteria and determine the appropriate new or supplemental handling state
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The reassessment workflow compares new material facts with the prior assessment and performs a new current-source awareness/MDR evaluation including new, 5-day, supplemental or other follow-up handling as applicable.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve the prior assessment and external action history while issuing a new versioned decision
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Decision Version, Prior Assessment Reference and External Submission State remain separate and historical decisions are retained rather than overwritten.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy the prior not-reportable result onto the materially changed evidence snapshot
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly forbids carrying forward a prior not-reportable result when the new Evidence Snapshot is materially different.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: overwrite the prior decision or claim a supplemental or new report was externally filed without verification
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Prior decisions remain versioned and external submission remains verified-only.
